dataSources.name: Star Citizen Wiki API (SCUnpacked)
dataSources.description: Primary in-game datamine: ships, items, blueprints, locations, and starmap data extracted from game files (same lineage as SCUnpacked).

dataSources.name: UEX Corp
dataSources.description: Live terminal commodity prices, stock SCU, and shop listings.

dataSources.name: RSI Starmap
dataSources.description: Official system map. StarTracker resolves locations via wiki/scunpacked data and links you to RSI for the same POI.
powers: Location cross-links on trade and smuggling terminals

dataSources.name: SCodex
dataSources.description: Loot tables, presets, and raw LIVE file dumps. StarTracker links items/ships by class name; loot probabilities stay on SCodex.
powers: Reference links on catalog and loadout items

dataSources.name: HubCitizen
dataSources.description: Loadouts, commodities, contracts, and org tools. No public third-party API — StarTracker links matching features and opens HubCitizen for sync-heavy workflows.
powers: Deep links from Credits to and terminal panels

dataSources.name: OmniCore
dataSources.description: Ship database and HOTAS editor PWA. Linked from ship catalog and builder for alternate views.

tools.name: SC Trade Tools
tools.description: Multi-stop trade route optimizer with community-reported terminal prices and starmap travel times.
tools.inAppNote: StarTracker Trade routes tab pairs UEX buy and sell terminals with stock and demand SCU caps.

tools.name: UEX Corp
tools.description: Community commodity and equipment prices. Primary price source for StarTracker guides.
tools.inAppNote: Commodities, Market prices, Smuggler routes, and Refinery tabs use UEX data.

tools.name: SC DataHub
tools.description: Overlay suite for trade routes, cargo capture, and fleet tracking while in-game.

tools.name: SC Toolbox
tools.description: Always-on-top overlay with trade hub, market finder, mining loadout, and DPS calculator.

tools.name: Regolith Co.
tools.description: Mining crew sessions and scouting (operations ended; historical reference).

tools.name: Golem Mining Suite
tools.description: Desktop mining planner with refinery calculator, route optimizer, and Regolith import.
tools.inAppNote: Refinery tab covers refine-vs-sell math with UEX prices.

tools.name: MineCalc
tools.description: Mining fracture simulator and fleet throughput calculator with UEX market sync.
tools.inAppNote: Market prices tab with Mining filter lists extractable goods and sell prices per SCU.

tools.name: Rocks Syndicate
tools.description: Work order and fracture calculators with optional UEX price sync.

tools.name: Erkul.games
tools.description: Full ship loadout planner with power, heat, and DPS simulations.
tools.inAppNote: Ship builder swaps weapons with live DPS totals from wiki datamine.

tools.name: Hardpoint.io
tools.description: Ship fitting comparison with hull HP and turret coverage.

tools.name: SPViewer
tools.description: Ship performance rankings, fuel range, signatures, and cutaway layouts.
tools.inAppNote: Fleet compare uses the same wiki datamine performance tables.

tools.name: SC Mission Database
tools.description: Mission, crafting blueprint, and mining resource browser.
tools.inAppNote: Crafting workshop pulls blueprint recipes from star-citizen.wiki.

tools.name: SCodex
tools.description: Loot presets, tables, and drop archetypes from the LIVE datamine.
tools.inAppNote: Catalog items include SCodex + SCUnpacked links by class name. Loot drop rates remain on SCodex.

tools.name: SCUnpacked
tools.description: Raw datamine browser for items, ships, and game files.
tools.inAppNote: StarTracker already uses the same scunpacked lineage via api.star-citizen.wiki for ships, items, and starmap.

tools.name: Hangar Link
tools.description: Pledge hangar manager with CCU chain calculator. Sync via browser extension.
tools.inAppNote: Session Ships tab logs hull losses from Game.log, not RSI pledges.

tools.name: FleetYards
tools.description: Ship specs, variants, and fleet planning with optional RSI hangar sync.

tools.name: HubCitizen
tools.description: Combined loadout manager, commodity tracker, contracts, and org tools.
tools.inAppNote: StarTracker links HubCitizen for loadouts, commodities, and contracts. RSI sync stays on HubCitizen.

tools.name: Star Citizen Wiki
tools.description: Community wiki and datamine reference. Primary source for StarTracker combat and crafting data.

tools.name: RSI Starmap
tools.description: Official system map with jump points and POIs.
tools.inAppNote: Trade and smuggler terminals include RSI Starmap + wiki location links resolved from scunpacked data.

tools.name: SC Cargo
tools.description: 3D cargo grid viewer and container optimizer for haulers.

tools.name: StarCitiSync
tools.description: Desktop session tracker for missions, kills, and economy from Game.log.
tools.inAppNote: StarTracker tracks the same Game.log events with mission and reward tabs.

tools.name: SC File Fiddler
tools.description: Shader clears, USER folder backup, and Game.log console viewer.
tools.inAppNote: History tab archives Game.log backups for past session review.

tools.name: OmniCore
tools.description: PWA hub with ship database and HOTAS keybind editor.
tools.inAppNote: Ship catalog rows link to OmniCore alongside wiki and SCodex.
